name: Inazuma City
description: Rising high atop the cliffs at the southern tip of Narukami Island, it was built during the Archon War and is the seat of power of the Shogunate and the Raiden Shogun. The city is renowned for its low crime rate and great many family businesses, and is considered to be the most lively and prosperous area in the nation. Most of Inazuma's population lives here, and as their numbers continue to grow the city tends to expand outward.
